title: The future of feedback: motivating performance improvement through feedback
author: Jackie Gnepp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bftxjnpn

steps.title: Pair participants
steps.instruction: Randomly pair members if working with a group.

steps.title: Assign roles
steps.instruction: Randomly assign the roles of Regional Manager or District Manager within each dyad by handing the participant the corresponding envelope of instructions.

steps.title: Conduct procedure in private
steps.instruction: Send each dyad to a private room to complete the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Instruct participants to open the instructions packet only after arriving in the room.
Ensure each packet contains printed instructions, background information, and the questionnaires.
